Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM** on 3 Aug, in this channel (ts 1785771720). Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

Per the channel, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard at that point. The only other guard detail in the channel is Mateo's 11:03 AM message: kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You marked both lanes working at 11:07 AM (posted 11:08).

The brain also has a ticket, SUP-5380, with an 08:12 update reading "Rebot failed; drivers queueing." That is earlier than your 10:42 post. The entry doesn't say who wrote it, so if the postmortem needs the true first report, check that ticket's history.
